//: Durable preferences for Claude Code's GLOBAL config, MERGED into ~/.claude.json every
time install.sh runs — the same key-by-key, additive merge as settings.stable.json.
A separate file because some preferences exist only as global-config keys, which Claude
Code reads from ~/.claude.json, not settings.json. That file is also Claude Code's live
state (account, per-project history), rewritten by every running session, so only name
a key here when it has no settings.json equivalent. A session writing the file at the
moment of the merge can undo it; re-running install.sh puts it back.
defaultToAgentsView  Running `claude` with no arguments opens agent view (the
`claude agents` dashboard) instead of a new conversation, so
sessions start there as background sessions and stay listed.
`claude "<prompt>"` still starts an ordinary session. Agent view
is a research preview, so its behaviour may change. Inside cmux
it never applies, since cmux's wrapper adds flags to every
launch; a zsh function covers that — see cmux/README.md.
